name: example battery service
description: The example battery service used in the DOTS workshop

relevant_links.name: Battery ESDL documentation
relevant_links.description: Details on the Battery esdl type

calculations.name: max_charge_and_discharge
calculations.description: sends the max amount of active power the battery can charge and discharge

outputs.name: max_charge_active_power
outputs.description: The amount of active power that can be charged by the Battery > 0

outputs.name: max_discharge_active_power
outputs.description: The amount of active power that can be discharged by the Battery < 0

calculations.name: charge_battery
calculations.description: (dis)-charge the battery with the amount of power supplied, throws an exception when the power exceeds the max (dis)charge power

inputs.name: active_power_to_charge
inputs.description: The amount of active power produced or consumed by the Battery > 0 means charging, < 0 means discharging
